end.summary:
Practised place value and expanded base-10 numbers using powers of 10.
Used examples such as 4,075, 5,030, and 7,080 to discuss zero as a placeholder.
Discussed bases, including allowed digits in base 5 and why “10” has different values in different bases.
Neel corrected the rule that digits in a base must be less than the base; teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place-value charts, powers of 10, grouping, and base-5 examples with Neel. Neel engaged by asking about the roles of zero and the meaning of “10” in different bases; the digit rule for base 5 was corrected during the lesson. The placeholder-zero mix-up in numbers such as 5,030 and the meaning of “10” across bases remained to revisit. At home, use a place-value chart to compare 530 and 5,030, saying each digit’s place aloud.

Aap keh rahe hain ki shunya kuch nahin jodta, isliye use hata sakte hain. Lekin 5,030 mein paanch hazaar ki jagah par hai; shunya hataakar 530 likhen to paanch sau ki jagah par aa jaata hai. Ab 7,08,346 mein aath ki jagah ka maan kya hai?
आठ... सात लाख आठ हज़ार... तो आठ का मतलब आठ हज़ार हुआ ना? पर board पर कुछ और लिखा है... 'hazaar' 'sau' 'das'... ये 5,0,?,0... क्या है? मुझे समझ नहीं आ रहा, थोड़ा और समझाओ ना?
Use hataakar is sankhya ki jagahen dikhati hoon. Saat ke baad das hazaar ki jagah khaali hai, phir aath aata hai. Aath ki jagah ka maan aap kaise bataayenge?
sau? das? yeh sab jagah ke naam hain na... aath ki jagah... mujhe dikhao na, board mein aath kahan hai? picture mein toh kuch likha nahi properly...

Haan, ye sab jagahon ke naam hain. Pehle sawaaliya nishaan the, isliye aath dikh nahi raha tha; ab har jagah ka ank saaf likh rahi hoon. Aath hazaar wali jagah par hai. Isliye aath ki jagah ka maan kya hoga?
आठ हज़ार... आठ हज़ार ही तो है ना? जगह का मान मतलब वही?
Haan, aapne aath hazaar kaha. Jagah ka maan matlab ank aur uski jagah ko milaakar milne wala maan. Ab aadhar paanch mein ank chaar ke baad kya aayega?
पाँच? मतलब 4 के बाद 5 आता है ना... पर आपने कहा base 5 में सिर्फ 0,1,2,3,4 होते हैं... तो 5 नहीं आ सकता? ये base 5 क्या चीज़ है, मुझे समझ नहीं आया.

Aap soch rahe hain ki chaar ke baad paanch likhna chahiye. Aadhar paanch ka matlab hai paanch cheezen hote hi unka ek samooh banana; isliye ek jagah par paanch ka ank nahi likhte. Jaise paanch kanche ho gaye, to kitne samooh bane?
पाँच कंचे... तो एक समूह? मतलब 1? लेकिन वो 1 तो हमारे base 10 में पाँच के लिए होता है ना... ये सब अलग-अलग base क्यों होते हैं? मुझे बस base 10 ही ठीक लगता है.

Haan, paanch kanchon ka ek samooh banta hai. Aapka sawaal sahi hai: alag aadhar bas ginne ke alag tareeke hain; das-das ke samooh se ginna bhi theek hai, paanch-paanch se bhi. Abhi paanch kanchon ka ek samooh bana, to bina samooh wale kitne kanche bache?
समूह में पाँच गए तो बाकी कुछ नहीं बचा... मतलब ज़ीरो? तो base 5 में भी ज़ीरो का मतलब कुछ नहीं ही है ना?

Haan, paanch kanchon ka ek samooh bana aur koi kancha nahi bacha. Yahaan shoonya batata hai ki samooh ke baahar wali jagah khaali hai; jagah phir bhi bani rehti hai. Aadhar paanch mein chaar ke baad, ek samooh aur shoonya bache hon to kaunse do ank likhenge?
एक... और ज़ीरो? मतलब 10? पर ये तो दस है ना?

Aadhar paanch mein ek samooh aur shoonya bache to 10 likhte hain. Aapko lag raha hai ki 10 hamesha das hota hai; lekin yahan wahi 10 paanch kanche gin raha hai. Ab bataiye, 10 aadhar das, aadhar do aur aadhar paanch mein kitne-kitne ka maan rakhta hai?
